solution.title: Oracle WebLogic 14c for C2M — Install, Configure & Domain Setup

products.name: Oracle WebLogic 14c for C2M — Install, Configure & Domain Setup — Commercial
products.short_description: Install and configure Oracle WebLogic 14c for C2M — domain, Admin/managed servers, Node Manager, data sources, JVM/startup — the middleware foundation, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Build the WebLogic 14c foundation C2M runs on

Oracle Utilities C2M runs on Oracle WebLogic Server — and a mis-built domain undermines everything above it. This solution installs and configures WebLogic 14c for C2M: the domain, Administration Server and managed servers, Node Manager, data sources, and the JVM/startup configuration C2M expects — the middleware foundation, done right and pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — WebLogic 14c for C2M: domain topology, Admin/managed servers, Node Manager, data sources, and how OUAF sits on the domain.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (certified WebLogic 14c + JDK, OS product account, DB connectivity, C2M entitlement).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to install WebLogic 14c, create the named domain, configure Admin/managed servers + Node Manager, set up data sources, tune JVM/startup, and validate the domain, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (domain up, managed servers running, data sources healthy) plus Best Practices for domain layout and Node Manager.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A correctly built WebLogic 14c foundation for C2M — domain, servers, Node Manager, and data sources healthy — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OWLS14C-Discovery.py — read-only inventory of the WebLogic 14c domain for C2M
    • OWLS14C-Remediation.sh — preview and (only with --apply) fix safe WebLogic 14c C2M config drift
    • OWLS14C-Report.py — read-only health/coverage report for the WebLogic 14c C2M domain
    • OWLS14C-ScopeHelper.sh — pin the domain/server/data-source targets the other scripts act on
    • OWLS14C-Validation.py — read-only pass/fail checks on the WebLogic 14c domain for C2M

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
